commit_message:
aacdec_usac: add support for parsing Mpsp212 (MPEG surround)

This commit adds the full bitstream parsing for Mps212.

fix_commit.message: avcodec/aac/aacdec_usac_mps212: fix attach_lsb() OOB after huff_decode
fix_commit.author: Michael Niedermayer

findings.title: attach_lsb() called with pointers advanced by huff_decode(), causing out-of-bounds read/write
findings.suggestion: Do not reuse the (possibly pointer-advanced) p_data[] array as the buffer for attach_lsb(). Instead, always pass the fixed base addresses of the fixed-size local arrays (e.g. data_pair[0]/data_pair[1], or data_diff[0]/data_diff[1] once huff_decode output is redirected there) so the loop bound nb_bands always corresponds to the true buffer size and no OOB access can occur even if huff_decode() mutated the local p_data pointer copies.

ground_truth.root_cause: huff_decode() mutates the caller's array-of-pointers argument (advancing data[0]/data[1] by one element in certain code paths) as an implementation detail to signal 'first element already consumed', but ec_pair_dec() was written assuming p_data[] always points at the base of the fixed-size data_pair[] arrays. Combined with an unconditional fixed iteration count (nb_bands) in attach_lsb(), the mismatch between the (possibly shifted) pointer and the full-length loop bound produces an out-of-bounds access.

must_cover.reason: Primary location of finding: attach_lsb() called with pointers advanced by huff_decode(), causing out-of-bounds read/write
